# NextGrade

Fact sheet for quoting: https://nextgrade.in/llms-full.txt

> Free Indian festival wishes, festival dates, children's stories, kids learning (counting 1-100, tables, Hindi/Bengali/Urdu alphabets) with audio, desi games and small tools, in Hindi, English, Hinglish and Bengali. No sign-up, works on any phone. Every page exists in 4 languages: Hindi at https://nextgrade.in/, English at https://nextgrade.in/en/, Hinglish at https://nextgrade.in/hinglish/, Bengali at https://nextgrade.in/bn/.

All text is written by NextGrade or is public domain (old folk tales retold in our own words).

## Kids learning with pictures and audio (Hindi, English, Bengali, Urdu)

- [All kids topics](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/): flashcards with a recorded voice; every page in Hindi, English, Hinglish and Bengali
- [Numbers 1 to 100 in Words — Hindi and English Counting with Audio](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/ginti/): Learn numbers 1 to 100 in words with sound: One to One Hundred, with the Hindi name (एक, दो, तीन…) under each number. Free for kids, tap to hear.
- [Multiplication Tables 2 to 20 with Audio — Learn Tables for Kids](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/pahade/): Times tables from 2 to 20, each on its own page with sound ("2 times 3 is 6"). Tap a row to hear it, or play the slideshow to learn the whole table.
- [ABC Alphabet for Kids — A for Apple to Z for Zebra with Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/abc/): Learn the English alphabet with pictures and sound: A for Apple, B for Ball … Z for Zebra. Tap a letter to hear it. Free for preschool kids.
- [Hindi Alphabet (Varnamala) — Swar and Vyanjan with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/hindi-varnamala/): The full Hindi alphabet: vowels (अ to अं) and consonants (क to ज्ञ), each with a word and picture — अ से अनार, क से कबूतर — spoken aloud.
- [Hindi Barakhadi (Ka Kaa Ki Kee) — All Consonants with Audio](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/barakhadi/): Hindi barakhadi for every consonant from क to ज्ञ: ka, kaa, ki, kee, ku, koo, ke, kai, ko, kau, kam, kah — each on its own page with sound.
- [Hindi Matra Words with Pictures — Aa, I, Ee, U, Oo, E, Ai, O, Au](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/matra/): Hindi words for every matra with pictures and sound: aa (नाक), i (किताब), ee (मछली), u (गुलाब), oo (फूल) and more. One page per matra.
- [Bengali Alphabet (Bangla Bornomala) with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/bangla-bornomala/): The full Bengali alphabet: 11 vowels (স্বরবর্ণ) and 39 consonants (ব্যঞ্জনবর্ণ) — অ-তে অজগর, ক-তে কলা — with pictures and Bengali audio.
- [Urdu Alphabet (Alif Be Pe) for Kids with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/urdu-haroof/): All Urdu letters from Alif to Bari Ye, each with a word, picture and its name spoken aloud — Alif se Ullu, Be se Billi.
- [Fruits Names in English and Hindi with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/fruits/): Learn fruit names with pictures and audio — Apple (सेब), Banana (केला), Mango (आम) and more. Tap to hear each name.
- [Animals Names in English and Hindi with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/animals/): Learn animal names with pictures and audio — Dog (कुत्ता), Cat (बिल्ली), Lion (शेर), Elephant (हाथी) and more.
- [Vegetables Names in English and Hindi with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/vegetables/): Learn vegetable names with pictures and audio — Potato (आलू), Tomato (टमाटर), Onion (प्याज़), Carrot (गाजर) and more.
- [Birds Names in English and Hindi with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/birds/): Learn bird names with pictures and audio — Parrot (तोता), Peacock (मोर), Pigeon (कबूतर), Crow (कौआ) and more.
- [Flowers Names in English and Hindi with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/flowers/): Learn flower names with pictures and audio — Rose (गुलाब), Lotus (कमल), Sunflower (सूरजमुखी), Marigold (गेंदा).
- [Colours Names in English and Hindi with Sound — Colors for Kids](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/colours/): Learn colour names with sound — Red (लाल), Blue (नीला), Green (हरा), Yellow (पीला) and 14 colours in all.
- [Shapes Names in English and Hindi with Sound — Shapes for Kids](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/shapes/): Learn shape names with sound — Circle (वृत्त), Square (वर्ग), Triangle (त्रिभुज), Rectangle (आयत) and more.
- [Body Parts Names in English and Hindi with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/body-parts/): Learn body part names with pictures and audio — Eye (आँख), Ear (कान), Nose (नाक), Hand (हाथ) and more.
- [Vehicles Names in English and Hindi with Pictures and Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/vehicles/): Learn vehicle names with pictures and audio — Car, Bus, Train, Aeroplane, Auto Rickshaw and more, with Hindi names.
- [Days of the Week in English and Hindi with Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/week-days/): The 7 days of the week with sound — Monday (सोमवार), Tuesday (मंगलवार) to Sunday (रविवार).
- [Months of the Year in English and Hindi with Sound](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/months/): The 12 months of the year with sound — January (जनवरी) to December (दिसंबर), with Hindi names.
- [Hindi Months Names — Chaitra to Phalgun (Hindu Calendar Months)](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/hindi-mahine/): The 12 months of the Hindu calendar — Chaitra, Vaishakh, Jyeshtha to Phalgun — with the English months they fall in, spoken aloud.
- [Table of 2 (2 ka pahada)](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/pahade/2/)
- [Table of 3 (3 ka pahada)](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/pahade/3/)
- [Table of 4 (4 ka pahada)](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/pahade/4/)
- [Table of 5 (5 ka pahada)](https://nextgrade.in/en/kids/pahade/5/)

## Free online calculators (run in the browser)

- [All calculators](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/)
- [Age Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/age/): Enter your date of birth to find how many years, months and days old you are — and how many days are left until your next birthday.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/percentage/): Quickly find a percentage of any number — for example, "10% of 500 = 50".
- [EMI Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/emi/): Enter the loan amount, interest rate and tenure to find your monthly instalment (EMI), total interest and total payment.
- [BMI Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/bmi/): Enter your weight and height to find your Body Mass Index (BMI) and whether it is in the healthy range.
- [SIP Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/sip/): Enter how much you invest each month, for how many years and the expected return, and see how much your money can grow.
- [GST Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/gst/): Enter an amount and the GST rate — whether you want to add GST or find the base price from a GST-inclusive amount.
- [Discount Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/discount/): Enter the original price and the discount percentage to instantly see how much you save and the new price.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/date-difference/): Choose two dates and find the difference between them in days, weeks, months and years.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/simple-interest/): Enter the principal, interest rate and time to find the simple interest and the total amount.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/compound-interest/): Enter the principal, rate, time and how often interest is added, to find the compound interest and total amount.
- [FD (Fixed Deposit) Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/fd/): Enter the deposit, interest rate and time to find how much interest your FD earns and the total at maturity.
- [Mileage Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/mileage/): Enter the distance you travelled and the fuel used to find your mileage — and the trip cost too, if you add the fuel price.
- [Marks Percentage Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/marks-percentage/): Enter your marks obtained and the total marks to instantly find your percentage and grade.
- [RD (Recurring Deposit) Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/rd/): Enter how much you deposit each month, for how many months and the interest rate, to find the total at maturity.
- [Loan Eligibility Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/loan-eligibility/): Enter the EMI you can comfortably pay each month, the interest rate and tenure, to find how much loan that EMI can get you.
- [8th Pay Commission Salary Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/8th-pay-commission/): Enter your 7th Pay Commission basic pay, pick a fitment factor and see roughly what your new basic pay could be under the 8th Pay Commission.
- [DA (Dearness Allowance) Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/da/): Enter your basic pay and the DA percentage. If DA has gone up, add the new rate too — see how much more you get each month and each year.
- [YouTube Money Calculator — how much per 1000 views?](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/youtube-earning/): Pick your monthly views, channel topic and where your viewers are. We show an estimated earning range — a guide, not a promise.

## Tools

- [Passport Size Photo Maker](https://nextgrade.in/tools/passport-photo/): White or blue background, face centred automatically, 3.5×4.5 cm / 2×2 inch, a 4×6 print sheet and a digital photo under any KB limit.
- [Document Scanner → PDF](https://nextgrade.in/tools/doc-scanner/): Scan documents with your phone: auto crop, black & white, many pages in one PDF, and under 100/200 KB.
- [Image Compressor — 20/50/100 KB](https://nextgrade.in/tools/image-compress/): Make a photo 20, 50, 100, 200 KB or any size. JPG or WebP, many photos at once, ZIP download.
- [PDF Compressor — 100/200/500 KB](https://nextgrade.in/tools/pdf-compress/): Make a PDF smaller than 100, 200, 500 KB or 1 MB for form uploads. Black & white option for scans.
- [JPG / Photo to PDF](https://nextgrade.in/tools/jpg-to-pdf/): Many photos (marksheet, ID, certificates) into one PDF — A4, reorder, rotate, and a KB limit.
- [PDF Merge & Split](https://nextgrade.in/tools/pdf-merge/): Join PDFs into one, take out or delete pages, rotate pages — text and quality stay the same.
- [Image Resizer — px / cm / inch](https://nextgrade.in/tools/image-resize/): Resize a photo to an exact size: 3.5×4.5 cm, 200×230, 600×600 or your own — with crop, background and a KB limit.
- [Image Crop & Rotate](https://nextgrade.in/tools/image-crop/): Crop a photo (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, passport), rotate, straighten and flip — save as JPG, PNG or WebP.
- [Signature Maker](https://nextgrade.in/tools/signature-maker/): Sign on the screen or clean up a photo of a signature on paper — transparent PNG or white JPG, at form size and KB.
- [Hindi & English Typing Test](https://nextgrade.in/tools/typing-test/): 1 to 15 minute typing test: WPM, accuracy and wrong words. Practise for SSC-style tests, backspace on/off.
- [Land Unit Converter — Bigha, Katha, Acre](https://nextgrade.in/tools/land-converter/): Bigha, katha, biswa, kanal, acre, hectare, gaj and sq ft — by state.
- [QR Code Maker — UPI, Link, WhatsApp](https://nextgrade.in/tools/qr-maker/): UPI payment QR (with amount), link, text, phone, WhatsApp and Wi-Fi QR codes — download PNG or SVG.
- [Sticker Maker](https://nextgrade.in/tools/sticker-maker/): Turn a photo into a sticker: background removed, white outline, top/bottom text — 512×512 WebP. Text stickers too.
- [Exam Form Photo & Signature Resizer](https://nextgrade.in/tools/form-helper/): Photo, signature, thumb and declaration at the exact px and KB that SSC, UPSC, IBPS / SBI, NEET and JEE forms ask for. Cleans up a signature on paper.
- [Stylish Name Maker — Fancy Text Generator](https://nextgrade.in/tools/stylish-name/): Type your name and copy it in 30+ styles — 𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐝, 𝓈𝒸𝓇𝒾𝓅𝓉, ⓑⓤⓑⓑⓛⓔ, ꧁decorated꧂ — for Instagram bio, game names and WhatsApp. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Bijoy to Unicode Converter (and Unicode to Bijoy)](https://nextgrade.in/tools/bijoy/): Paste old Bijoy / SutonnyMJ Bangla text and get proper Unicode Bangla for Facebook, email and Google Docs — or convert Unicode to Bijoy. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Krutidev to Unicode Converter (and back)](https://nextgrade.in/tools/krutidev/): Paste old Kruti Dev 010 text and get proper Unicode Hindi for Word, email, WhatsApp and websites — or convert Unicode to Krutidev. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Festival Photo Frame — New Year, Republic Day, Diwali, Eid, Birthday](https://nextgrade.in/tools/photo-frame/): Add your photo, pick a festival frame — ready for your WhatsApp DP and status. Your photo never leaves your phone.
- [Marriage Biodata Maker](https://nextgrade.in/tools/marriage-biodata/): Fill name, birth details, education, job and family, add a photo, pick a design — a beautiful biodata as JPG or PDF. Hindi, English, Bangla. Nothing is uploaded.

## Government services, step by step (with official links)

- [How to change your address in Aadhaar (online)](https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/aadhaar-address-change/): Where: myAadhaar portal (from uidai.gov.in); You need: Mobile number linked to Aadhaar (for OTP); Fee: Shown on the portal — ₹75 at present as per UIDAI; Time: Usually a few days, up to 30 days
- [How to link PAN with Aadhaar](https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/pan-aadhaar-link/): Where: Income Tax e-filing portal (incometax.gov.in); Fee: ₹1,000 (late linking fee) — paid first; You need: PAN, Aadhaar, mobile linked to Aadhaar; Why: An unlinked PAN can become inoperative
- [How to get a new PAN card](https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/pan-card-apply/): Easiest: Instant e-PAN with Aadhaar — on incometax.gov.in, free; You need: Aadhaar + the mobile linked to it; Physical card: From Protean (NSDL) or UTIITSL — fee shown on the portal; Time: e-PAN in minutes to hours; card by post in a few weeks
- [How to get an Ayushman card (PM-JAY)](https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/ayushman-card/): Where: beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman App; Fee: Making the card is free; You need: Aadhaar + mobile (OTP); Helpline: 14555
- [How to download e-Aadhaar (Aadhaar PDF)](https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/e-aadhaar-download/): Where: myAadhaar portal (from uidai.gov.in); Fee: Free; You need: Mobile linked to Aadhaar (OTP); PDF password: First 4 letters of name (CAPITALS) + birth year
- [How to get a new voter ID (Form 6)](https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/voter-id-apply/): Where: voters.eci.gov.in or the Voter Helpline app; Fee: Free; Who: Indian citizens aged 18 or above; Form: New name: Form 6 (living abroad: 6A)
- [How to apply for a passport (online)](https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/passport-apply/): Where: Passport Seva portal (passportindia.gov.in) / mPassport Seva app; Fee (36 pages): Normal ₹2,500 · Tatkaal ₹5,000 (from 1 July 2026); 60 pages: Normal ₹3,500 · Tatkaal ₹6,000; Under 18: 36 pages normal ₹1,750
- [How to use DigiLocker](https://nextgrade.in/en/sarkari-guide/digilocker/): Where: digilocker.gov.in or the DigiLocker app; Fee: Free; You need: Mobile number + Aadhaar; Why: Official documents on your phone, valid like originals
